crossRefs.note: and to another workings of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discerning of spirits; to another…
God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of…
Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?
David went up by the ascent of the Mount of Olives, and wept as he went up; and he had his head covered, and went…
The king covered his face, and the king cried with a loud voice, “My son Absalom, Absalom, my son, my son!”

translations.web: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.
translations.bsb: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.
translations.kjv: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
translations.asv: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoreth his head.
